name: vgallery-complete
description: V. Gallery - Art + Commerce, with Paystack, Flutterwave, and bank/domiciliary transfer support

scripts.build:js: terser public/js/app.js -o dist/js/app.js -c -m --compress drop_console=true && terser public/js/utils.js -o dist/js/utils.js -c -m && terser public/js/payment-callback.js -o dist/js/payment-callback.js -c -m && terser public/admin/admin-app.js -o dist/admin/admin-app.js -c -m && terser public/admin/admin-login.js -o dist/admin/admin-login.js -c -m
scripts.build:css: csso public/css/styles.css -o dist/css/styles.css && csso public/admin/admin.css -o dist/admin/admin.css
scripts.build:html: html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true public/index.html -o dist/index.html && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true public/payment-callback.html -o dist/payment-callback.html && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true public/admin/index.html -o dist/admin/index.html && html-minifier-terser --collapse-whitespace --remove-comments --minify-css true --minify-js true public/admin/dashboard.html -o dist/admin/dashboard.html
scripts.build: npm run build:js && npm run build:css && npm run build:html
